51: class DBusMockObject(dbus.service.Object):
52:     '''Mock D-Bus object
53: 
54:     This can be configured to have arbitrary methods (including code execution)
55:     and properties via methods on the org.freedesktop.DBus.Mock interface, so
56:     that you can control the mock from any programming language.
57:     '''
58: 
59:     def __init__(self, bus_name, path, interface, props, logfile=None):
60:         '''Create a new DBusMockObject
61: 
62:         bus_name: A dbus.service.BusName instance where the object will be put on
63:         path: D-Bus object path
64:         interface: Primary D-Bus interface name of this object (where
65:                    properties and methods will be put on)
66:         props: A property_name (string) → property (Variant) map with initial
67:                properties on "interface"
68:         logfile: When given, method calls will be logged into that file name;
69:                  if None, logging will be written to stdout. Note that you can
70:                  also query the called methods over D-BUS with GetCalls() and
71:                  GetMethodCalls().
72:         '''
73:         super(self.__class__, self).__init__(bus_name, path)
74: 
75:         self.bus_name = bus_name
76:         self.interface = interface
77:         # interface -> name -> value
78:         self.props = {}
79:         self.props[interface] = props
80: 
81:         # interface -> name -> (in_signature, out_signature, code, dbus_wrapper_fn)
82:         self.methods = {interface: {}}
83: 
84:         if logfile:

86:         else:

source_summary: The 'name' parameter to load_module() comes from: 1) D-Bus AddTemplate() method calls (template parameter), 2) testcase.py spawn_server_template() calls (template parameter), 3) __main__.py command line arguments (args.template). D-Bus methods are remotely callable.
sink_summary: importlib.import_module() dynamically loads and executes Python modules. When name is a file path (.py extension), it adds the directory to sys.path and imports the module name without extension.
guard_summary: Limited validation: checks if file exists and has .py extension before path manipulation. No validation of template names for package imports. No authentication or authorization on D-Bus methods. Path manipulation occurs before import.
risk_pattern: Remotely controllable D-Bus method parameter flows through minimal validation to dynamic module import with sys.path manipulation, enabling arbitrary Python code execution.
used_variable_sources: template parameter to AddTemplate() D-Bus method
context_summary: The load_module function handles both file paths (with .py extension) and template names. For files, it manipulates sys.path to import from arbitrary directories. The function is called from D-Bus exposed methods and test utilities.
